Antwerp bureau: LVMH's jewellery and watch division is growing eight times faster than the group that owns it.

Antwerpen: de juwelen- en horlogedivisie van LVMH groeit acht keer sneller dan de groep zelf.

Tiffany, Bulgari and Chaumet's division took €2.5bn in Q3, up 8%, while LVMH revenue rose just 1% to €18.5bn. Nine months: division up 4% to €7.73bn, group down 1.6%.
